Hi all -

Thanks, Priya. Confirming what we provide for training opt-out (hosted API only):

Signable wording (suggested single sentence for addendum):
"Customer requests that Redwood exclude Customer Data from use in model improvement, training, or derivative-modeling efforts for Redwood-hosted services; Redwood will honor this request for the account identified in the Contract."

Technical controls / operational notes:
- Account flag: `training_opt_out` (boolean) - when true, inbound request payloads for hosted API are routed to an opt-out path that prevents inclusion in any training or human review pipelines.
- Logging & retention: request logs (request ID, timestamp, routing metadata) are retained for 90 days for troubleshooting and abuse investigation. No request payloads or model responses are persisted to training datasets.
- Access & audit: security/audit logs available to customers via our Shared Audit Portal (view-only) for a 90-day window. We can provide export on request for compliance reviews.
- Dedicated/Private: as noted, opt-out for hosted API only; Dedicated/Private handled per separate agreement.

I've attached an excerpt from the DPA that highlights retention and audit access (DPA_excerpt.pdf). Marissa - once we receive the signed form, please set the HubSpot flag and create a compliance ticket to record the exportable audit link.

Happy to jump on a short call if legal wants to review the wording.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachment: DPA_excerpt.pdf
